# Parkinson's disease — neurobiology and disease landscape

> 8 concept packs from the research run on neurobiology and disease landscape (dopamine circuits, alpha-synuclein spread, neurodegeneration mechanisms, atypical parkinsonism, Lewy body dementia and age, sex and ancestry differences); 57 of the family's 1,155 claims are grouped under this section in llms-facts.txt. Educational research reference, not medical advice.
> Source: research run parkinsons-neurobiology-and-landscape · Generated: 2026-11-27 by llms-deep-optimizer v1.2.1 · Mode: family

## Concept packs

- [Run-level pack: Neurobiology and disease landscape](https://llmsx.org/tree/parkinson-s-disease-neurobiology-and-landscape-dopamine-circuits-alpha-synuclein-spread-atypical-parkinsonism-lewy-body-dementia-and-subgroups/): Run-level pack covering dopamine circuits, alpha-synuclein spread, neurodegeneration mechanisms, atypical parkinsonism, Lewy body dementia
- [Alpha-synuclein biology and prion-like spread](https://llmsx.org/tree/alpha-synuclein-biology-and-prion-like-spread/): Braak staging proposed an ascending pattern of Lewy pathology, and a body-first versus brain-first hypothesis proposes different sites of origin
- [Alpha-synucleinopathies: PD, DLB and MSA](https://llmsx.org/tree/alpha-synucleinopathies-pd-dlb-and-msa/): The cited human-brain studies and amplification experiments support molecular diversity within this disease family
- [Atypical parkinsonism: MSA, PSP and CBD](https://llmsx.org/tree/atypical-parkinsonism-msa-psp-and-cbd/): Consensus criteria organize clinical features, while clinicopathological validation highlights the limits of equating corticobasal syndrome with CBD pathology
- [Basal ganglia circuitry and dopamine neurobiology](https://llmsx.org/tree/basal-ganglia-circuitry-and-dopamine-neurobiology/): The cited circuit review describes their anatomy, while Cui and colleagues provide mouse evidence that qualifies a simple opposing-pathways account of movement
- [Dementia with Lewy bodies and Parkinson's disease dementia](https://llmsx.org/tree/dementia-with-lewy-bodies-and-parkinson-s-disease-dementia/): The evidence covers cognitive profiles, clinical criteria, pathological heterogeneity, diagnostic limitations, symptomatic treatment evidence and antipsychotic sensitivity
- [Movement disorders and neurodegeneration landscape](https://llmsx.org/tree/movement-disorders-and-neurodegeneration-landscape/): Parkinsonism describes a movement syndrome rather than a specific diagnosis, and secondary causes broaden its differential diagnosis
- [Neurodegeneration mechanisms: proteostasis, mitochondria and neuroinflammation](https://llmsx.org/tree/neurodegeneration-mechanisms-proteostasis-mitochondria-and-neuroinflammation/): Human immune observations and model findings have different causal scope; pathway activation alone does not establish completed mitochondrial clearance
- [Sex, age and ancestry differences and young-onset PD](https://llmsx.org/tree/sex-age-and-ancestry-differences-and-young-onset-pd/): Korean genetic association findings illustrate population-specific research while remaining limited by statistical power

## Top sources, live-checked 2026-11-27

- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5496518 (8 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5496518/): The DLB Consortium states that biomarkers alone do not establish probable DLB
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9547138 (7 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9547138/): The task force recommends the term early-onset Parkinson’s disease rather than young-onset Parkinson’s disease
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8347623 (5 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8347623/): The reviews describe alpha-synuclein as a protein concentrated at presynaptic nerve terminals
- [fens.org/news-activities/news (4 claims in this run)](https://www.fens.org/news-activities/news/why-does-parkinsons-disease-affect-more-men-than-women-study-reveals-differences-in-gene-activity-in-the-brain): The FENS release states that a limitation of the presented study is the small number of samples investigated
- [elifesciences.org/articles/92775 (3 claims in this run)](https://elifesciences.org/articles/92775): Lee and colleagues report that their SAA fibrils failed to adopt the biochemical, structural and post-translational modification properties of the brain-derived seed fibrils
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11123577 (3 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11123577/): The epidemiology review cautions that apparent ethnic differences in Parkinson’s disease risk may reflect differential access to health care
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2865395 (3 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2865395/): In the US Medicare study, age-standardized Parkinson disease incidence and prevalence were greater in men than women across the racial groups studied
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5410576 (3 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5410576/): The Mouton-Liger review describes mammalian-cell evidence that PINK1 and Parkin jointly regulate clearance of dysfunctional mitochondria through autophagy and lysosomal degradation, termed mitophagy
